summary: Add an internal typed evidence contract with no user-visible change

replay.detail: No claims, replay or projections change. The contract is in memory only.

schema.detail: No schema or storage version changes; the internal types have no serde implementation.

rules.detail: Internal validation covers required text, subject and immutable document evidence and exact bounds. Agent-review remains rejected by mission parsing.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or publication changes; existing gate kinds and human review behavior are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime behavior or restart-time work changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the internal type and tests; no data recovery is needed.
